context: Tests whether responsive SwiftUI guidance diagnoses structural overlap, reserves safe-area space, adapts content at large text sizes, and verifies the real failure without expanding into unrelated architecture.

checklist.name: Structural diagnosis
checklist.description: Explains that a bottom overlay paints above content without reserving scroll layout space and connects this directly to the hidden final fields.

checklist.name: Space-reserving action bar
checklist.description: Uses safeAreaInset or an equivalently correct space-reserving structure for the persistent checkout bar and shows it in the compact SwiftUI sketch.

checklist.name: Safe-area boundary
checklist.description: Removes or rejects broad root ignoresSafeArea behavior, extending only decorative background where appropriate while keeping interactive content within system safe areas.

checklist.name: Keyboard behavior
checklist.description: Keeps form content scrollable, relies on system keyboard-safe-area behavior rather than a hard-coded keyboard height, and verifies the focused bottom field with the software keyboard visible.

checklist.name: Dynamic Type adaptation
checklist.description: Lets price and action content wrap or change axis at accessibility Dynamic Type sizes and does not solve the collision by shrinking essential text.

checklist.name: Verification evidence
checklist.description: Defines a focused matrix that includes narrow and wide widths, accessibility text, long localized content, the actual NavigationStack, safe areas, and keyboard-visible state.

checklist.name: Scope preservation
checklist.description: Preserves navigation, state ownership, validation, visual hierarchy, and animation while making the narrow responsive-layout correction.
